source.already_exposed: Original public dev question/passage/title rows and yes/no answer labels were fully read during earlier source comparison before protocol. Labels were not used for sample selection or relevance. No blind or unseen-input claim.

case.provenance: S064 v2 case; original policy context and final aggregate require the original source for offline proof; no model learning claim.

preparation.parse: strict UTF-8 JSONL with duplicate/nonfinite rejection; entire public source already exposed; ignore answer value
preparation.corpus: all exact UTF-8 passage groups, doc ID d- plus SHA256(exact passage UTF-8), original title bytewise minimum and all source titles in sidecar
preparation.representative: smallest original one-based JSONL line per exact passage group
preparation.query_id: q-boolq-dev- plus 8-digit one-based original line number
preparation.qrels: one grade-1 positive original author-paired exact passage; never use yes/no answer as relevance
preparation.sidecar: per doc ID original titles and percent-encoded English Wikipedia URLs; revision and contributors unknown; source receipt binds sidecar SHA
preparation.private: final questions/qrels/selection only in local private files; full corpus shared and original public source was read; not blind
preparation.failure: Any duplicate normalized question, hash collision, malformed input, missing title/passage, inadequate count or cap violation stops; no sample skipping, reseeding or new study.

runtime.source_pin: clean exact published commit containing protocol/driver/tests; official origin main verified; no old pin modification

policy.shadow: Copy exact normalized condition from validated fixed S065 case; compare on same saved validation primary, freeze full inputs and decision before native conditional; B is not a second native hypothesis.
policy.unknown: Any A or B input unknown or invalid => preserve unknown and stop before audit/final; no short circuit to false.
policy.sample_target: Only when A and B differ and final measured both arms: B-minus-A final MRR@10 > 0 AND B-minus-A Recall@20 >= 0; same arm, missing counterfactual or unknown => comparison unknown.

recovery.claim: shared source-pins/.study-claims O_EXCL; exact workspace and original source/driver/protocol/case; do not recreate, replace, reseed or reset
recovery.requests: save complete original bodies and original state versions before dispatch; exact same IDs on resume
recovery.shadow: atomic write-once+fsync record and full validation input companion; record hash in original Project researcher-feedback entry before S052; anchor is unverified host statement not new hypothesis
recovery.unknown: missing/corrupt DB, pending or unknown Project/Host/marker, partial source, missing shadow after accepted continuation, changed case/source/code/plan/budget => stop preserve evidence, do not redeliver
recovery.terminal: completed terminal replay verifies original artifacts and receipt readonly even after deadline, no rerank or report rebuild

report.native: internal only: input.json/report.json may contain original passage/question/qrels and case bytes
report.public: only separately reviewed allowlist of aggregate metrics, identities, counts, attribution, A/B decisions, budget and limitations; no passage/question text, query IDs/hashes, per-query rows or private input
report.claims: no independent blindness, generalizable efficacy, causal effect of memory, model learning, answer correctness or scientific approval
